value.rationale: Clipping a two-level Hermitian spectrum at zero is a canonical projection onto the positive cone. The exact full local S1 and S∞ conditioning function and the sharp ratio boundary 1+sqrt2 classify when noncommuting infinitesimal perturbations are amplified, despite S2 nonexpansion. The boundary is mathematically motivated by conditioning and does not follow solely from the well-known endpoint Schur norm. It resolves a natural local invariant for every nonzero mixed-sign eigenpair, not an arbitrary finite numerical sample.
